title: A missing event, help or topic page says "index, follow", and a few member pages answer 200 to a crawler

source.ref: SEO, GEO and speed deep scan 2026-11-19 (production crawl of 3,000 URLs, all 720 sitemap pages, 8 crawler user agents, Lighthouse on 14 templates)

detail: The not-found page for an event, a help article and a topic answers 404 but its robots meta says index, follow (harmless to Google, confusing to simpler crawlers). /feed answers 200 and indexable to a signed-out request (robots keeps crawlers out, the page itself does not say noindex). /events/calendar is indexable and not in the sitemap. 686 /sign-in?next=... addresses were crawled; they are noindex and left crawlable on purpose. The site has no web app manifest, apple-touch-icon or security.txt.

verify.evidence: Production crawl, 2026-11-19: 404 responses for /events/<missing>, /help/<missing> and /topics/<missing> carried robots "index, follow"; /feed returned 200 with no noindex; /manifest.webmanifest, /apple-touch-icon.png and /.well-known/security.txt returned 404.
